gen-gf-unica-one-mulish: Mulish is modern and approachable, with horseshoe-open curves and a large x-height, while Unica One brings commanding, uniform-stroke display letters. Give Unica One generous size and let Mulish stay modest.
gen-irish-grover-inter: Inter draws ruler-straight lines with big counters, a smooth tube-like look running through every line of text. And Irish Grover loosens it up, its softly shifting stroke weight like brushed watercolor.
gen-almendra-display-gf-fauna-one: Fauna One is dignified, with a tall middle band and shallow ascenders. Almendra Display is the ornate, literary voice up top, its letters never pinching shut and its x-height pronounced.
gen-almendra-display-gf-glegoo: Ornate letters that never pinch shut, courtesy of Almendra Display. Glegoo then settles into a refined editorial voice, its big counters and wide curve mouths keeping paragraphs of text easy going.
gen-almendra-display-gf-hanuman: Hanuman is a traditional, refined text serif, quiet and formal. Its high-waisted lowercase and wide-set s terminals make a steady partner for the ornate, literary letters of Almendra Display.
gen-almendra-display-gf-kadwa: Ornate and literary, Almendra Display never lets its letters pinch shut. Kadwa, classic and editorial, takes over the running text with open-ended curves and a noticeably larger-than-usual x-height.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noticia-text: Never-pinched letters and a pronounced x-height give Almendra Display its ornate, literary look. But Noticia Text stays dignified across a page, with big visible entrances into curved letters and tall-bodied lowercase.
gen-almendra-display-gf-piazzolla: Piazzolla is refined and authoritative, its lowercase nearly matching the capitals. Piazzolla also opens its e like a pried clasp, so a modest body size still reads clearly beside Almendra Display.
gen-almendra-display-gf-pridi: Letters that never pinch shut and a pronounced x-height give Almendra Display its distinctly ornate, literary character. Pridi, classic and refined, quietly does the work of carrying the text.
gen-almendra-display-gf-slabo-13px: Slabo 13px is bookish and dignified, with large open counters inside its tall a, s and e. Slabo 13px then keeps paragraphs inviting, while Almendra Display handles the ornate, literary flourish up top.
